findings.label: Research should count stuck passes per node: drop the loopType===review term from nodeScoped (convergence.cjs:1774-1778) and bind the research nodeId to the latest focus marker; breadth-first rotation makes the lineage-wide count close the wrong node (deep-research.yaml:1523-1532). Value M-H, effort S, risk low.

Measured: 78 of 343 committed research lineages (23%) fail the research completion rule retroactively (72 no terminal row, 6 no iteration row; 26 have config status complete); the 3 of 12 in the topic is a sample of this rate.

The completion check does not break resume or extend (post-attempt only, window-scoped; extend refused with fan-out), but re-dispatching a completed lineage halts at completed-session and fails stale_terminal_event; classify before spawn and skip lineages complete by terminal row or completionFromArtifacts. Value H, effort S-M, risk low.

Cheap pivot admission: send the accepted candidate through frontier-admit admit as a depth-2 frontier_proposal under the last worked node with inherited scope; band carry funds depth 2 once the frontier is drained and frontierOpen holds the stop; fall back to D-011-10 when pruned. Value M, effort S-M, risk medium.
